description: Run DeepSeek Harness (dsh) inside BOSS. Installs and supervises the harness, embeds its Web UI in a tab, feeds it the API key BOSS already manages, and exposes dsh_* tools so in-terminal agents can drive it.
author: Risa Labs

definedPermissions.name: dsh.run
definedPermissions.description: Let agents submit tasks to DeepSeek Harness. Each task spends model tokens and can read and write files in the workspace it runs against.

definedPermissions.name: dsh.manage
definedPermissions.description: Let agents change DeepSeek Harness state: start and stop its server, and add or remove profile bundles
